label: Шкаф
description: Singular case ladder for шкаф (cupboard / wardrobe), with the stressed -у́ locative в шкафу́, accusative motion, adjective agreement, and one plural form.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Adjective plus noun. 1. 'Шкаф' is the nominative subject of 'стоит'. 2. 'Большой' agrees as masculine nominative singular. 3. This is the baseline agreement pattern for the noun.
Strategic focus: Modified noun. 1. 'Шкаф' stays nominative as subject. 2. 'Кухонный' agrees as masculine nominative singular. 3. The adjective narrows the noun to a kitchen cupboard.
Strategic focus: Identification. 1. 'Это' opens a naming statement. 2. 'Шкаф' is nominative as the named object. 3. 'Новый' agrees masculine nominative singular.
Strategic focus: Direct object. 1. 'Открыл' is past-tense transitive. 2. 'Шкаф' is accusative; for this inanimate masculine noun it matches the nominative. 3. A high-frequency action pattern.
Strategic focus: Accusative motion. 1. 'В шкаф' with accusative marks direction into the cupboard. 2. 'Положил' is the placing verb. 3. Motion takes plain accusative шкаф, not the locative.

Strategic focus: Accusative goal. 1. 'В шкаф' is accusative, expressing movement into the cupboard. 2. 'Поставила' sets an object upright. 3. Direction uses accusative, contrasting with the locative of location.
Strategic focus: Stressed locative. 1. 'В шкафу́' is the special locative in stressed -у́, marking location inside. 2. 'Вещи' is the nominative subject. 3. Location uses в шкафу, never в шкафе.
Strategic focus: Location verb. 1. 'Лежит' states a static position. 2. 'В шкафу́' uses the stressed -у́ locative for being inside. 3. This contrasts with motion's accusative в шкаф.
Strategic focus: On-top location. 1. 'На шкафу́' uses the stressed -у́ locative for resting on top. 2. 'Ваза' is the nominative subject. 3. The -у́ locative also follows на here, not -е.
Strategic focus: Genitive of belonging. 1. 'Шкафа' is genitive, marking possession. 2. 'Дверца' is the possessed item, the little door. 3. Genitive links the part to its whole.
Strategic focus: Genitive source. 1. 'Из шкафа' uses genitive after из to mark origin. 2. 'Достал' means took out. 3. Removal from inside takes genitive, mirroring entry's accusative.
Strategic focus: Dative goal. 1. 'К шкафу' is dative after к, marking approach toward. 2. 'Подошёл' means walked up. 3. Note plain dative -у here, distinct from the stressed locative в шкафу́.
Strategic focus: Dative direction. 1. 'Иду' is first-person present motion. 2. 'К шкафу' is dative, naming the cupboard as destination. 3. Dative -у marks movement toward an object.

Strategic focus: Instrumental location. 1. 'За шкафом' is instrumental after за, marking the space behind. 2. 'Спрятался' states the resulting position. 3. Instrumental -ом expresses static placement behind the object.
Strategic focus: Instrumental above. 1. 'Над шкафом' is instrumental after над, marking the space above. 2. 'Полка' is the nominative subject. 3. Instrumental -ом fits position over the cupboard.

Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 1. 'О шкафе' is the prepositional case after о, naming the topic of thought. 2. 'Думаю' means I think. 3. With о the ending is plain -е, unlike the locative в шкафу́.

Strategic focus: Plural nominative. 1. 'Шкафы́' is the nominative plural with stressed ending. 2. 'Новые' agrees as plural. 3. 'Здесь' anchors the scene; plural broadens the noun to several cupboards.
